serviceDetails.title: How fast can you reach me?
paras: We aim to have an engineer at your door within 60 to 90 minutes, or at a time which suits you. serviceDetails.title: What should I do if I smell gas?
paras: Your safety comes first. If you smell gas, follow these steps immediately:
list: Do not use light switches, sockets or sparks
Do not smoke or use naked flames
Turn off the gas at the meter if you can
parasAfter: Once the gas supply is made safe, call us. Our Gas Safe engineers find and fix the leak and test your appliances before turning things back on.

serviceDetails.title: What should I do if a pipe bursts?
paras: Turn off your water at the stop tap straight away. It is usually under the kitchen sink or where the water pipe enters your home. Switch off the electrics in any area where water is near sockets or lights, and turn off your boiler. Then call us. We stop the leak, repair the pipe and get your water back on.
serviceDetails.alt: Engineer repairing a burst pipe in an emergency

serviceDetails.title: Are you safe to call for gas faults?

serviceDetails.title: Will I know the cost before you start?

serviceDetails.title: How can I prevent a winter emergency?
paras: Many winter call outs can be avoided. Book a yearly boiler service before the cold weather. Lag pipes in lofts and garages. Know where your stop tap is and check it turns. Keep the heating on low when you go away in winter. If your condensate pipe freezes, pouring warm, not boiling, water over it can often get your boiler going again.
